script_text: Scorpio, this week kicks off with Jupiter squaring your 8th House of transformation — expect emotional intensity and power struggles that demand your authenticity. Monday-Tuesday feels heavy as the Sun conjuncts Pluto, forcing deep reckonings, but Wednesday brings relief as Venus enters your 5th House of pleasure, lighting up romance and creative projects. Thursday marks a turning point: Mercury trines your 2nd House, making it easier to manifest financial gains and clear communication. By weekend, the Moon opposes your Sun, creating tension but also revealing hidden truths. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, activating love and joy. Monday is your worst day because Jupiter squares your 8th House, amplifying fears. Weekly advice: release control over outcomes and trust the process. Follow for daily updates.
